# telnyx_number_order_phone_numbers (Data Source)

The phone numbers in the account's number orders.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `filter_country_code` (String) Country code of the order phone number.
- `max_items` (Number) Stop reading after this many items. By default every page is read.

### Read-Only

- `number_order_phone_numbers` (Attributes List) The objects, in the order the API returns them. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--number_order_phone_numbers))
